title: Expanded Universe
description: Expanding Minecraft beyond the bounds of the universe.
body:
Ever looked and Minecraft and thought; "Man, this game is great. But I think it's missing the destruction caused by a maniac," to yourself? No? Gee, I wonder why...

Well, luckily for you, this mod isn't that. Welcome to Expanded Universe!

![expanded universe logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b1d6584198e5926029fd6baf11128ba79a021bf.png)

Expanded Universe is the long-awaited sequel to Expanded World. Much like it's predecessor, Expanded Universe is a mod that aims to add more content to Minecraft for players to explore; This time having much, much more content planned, and sporting a far more vanilla feel than before.

Just a few of the features seen in this mod include;

- Enderite; A new tier above netherite
- Many, Many new Music Discs
- A new Sculk Biome
- A use for the fletching table, alongside a number of new exclusive arrows
- Several New Armor & Tool Sets with unique drawbacks and benefits
- New Woodsets
- Shield Tiers

And there is so much more to explore, and so much more coming in the future. So I hope you'll enjoy my mod.

Information Section:

This mod is, and will only ever be for, NeoForge 1.21.8. I have no way to port it at all, period. Please don't ask me to port it to another modloader or minecraft version.

If you have suggestions or want to report a bug, I accept both in the [Official Discord Server.](https://discord.gg/Jj3zRQB3nT)
